newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Q1 cement output rises 7.95 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Q1 cement output rises 7.95 percent.

text.p: Peru's cement output was 997,446 tonnes in the first quarter of the year, up 7.95 percent over the same period last year, the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM) said Thursday.
Output in March was 519,204 tonnes, up from 318,476 tonnes in the same month last year, ASOCEM said.
The biggest cement producer in the first quarter of the year was Cementos Lima with 454,354 tonnes, followed by Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with 197,183 tonnes.
Peru produced 3.848 million tonnes of cement in 1996
